narration: TagTune. Paste a YouTube link, and get back a properly tagged song.
It's a small desktop app for Linux. Paste a link, even a music video, and press download.
Instead of ripping the video, with its intro and its skits, TagTune looks for the official recording on YouTube Music, and downloads that.
Then it fills in the artist, title, album, year and cover art, from MusicBrainz, iTunes or Deezer, and files the song away.
Everything you've saved shows up in the library. Search it as you type, and double click a song to play it.
It follows your system's light or dark setting, or you can switch it yourself.
TagTune is open source. The code is on GitHub.
